summary: v43.71 Plan Feature Guard + Tenant Isolation backend testing. Created pytest suite (11 tests) covering /api/plan/effective for visitor/master/bayi (starter/pro), verified all new v43.71 module keys present in features (mailscanner, mail_health, live_diagnostic, my_server, docs_view, whitelist_history, marketplace, bounce_digest, notifications_view, users_view), GET/POST/reset on /api/admin/plan-matrix with immediate bayi reflection, and tenant isolation via /api/events (per-bayi scope, no leak to master or other bayi). All 11 tests PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 10532 lines — should be split into feature modules (plan_matrix, licensing, events, admin, etc). Well over the 700-line guideline.
PLAN_FEATURES_DEFAULT/matrix logic and admin endpoints duplicate schemas (starter/pro/enterprise); extract shared feature registry to prevent drift when adding new keys.

In parallel test runs (pytest-xdist loadscope) the plan-matrix toggle/reset test races other bayi tests — production API is fine but consider serializing writes in admin_plan_matrix_set or documenting that clients should refresh after write. Not a blocker.
